facts.fact: Tunisia's communications technologies ministry said the G-Cloud and N-Cloud labelling system implements Decree-Law 2023-17 of 11 March 2023 and the minister's decision of 13 September 2023 setting the procedures and conditions for awarding the labels.

The National Cybersecurity Agency awarded the government cloud (G-Cloud) label to Standard Sharing Software (3S) and EO Data Center in July 2024, after Next Step IT received the first N-Cloud label in April 2024.
